dialogues.jp: 「ひとりが気楽でいいか」
dialogues.en: "I'm more comfortable alone anyway."
dialogues.text: "I'm more comfortable alone anyway."

dialogues.jp:
音夢と帰ってもいいけど、寄り道させてもらえ
ないし。
dialogues.en:
If I go home with Nemu, she'd probably get distracted along
the way.
dialogues.text:
If I go home with Nemu, she'd probably get distracted along
the way.

dialogues.jp: 場所によるかもしれないけど。
dialogues.en: Who knows where we'd end up.
dialogues.text: Who knows where we'd end up.

dialogues.jp: （杉並は問題外）
dialogues.en: "(Suginami is another problem entirely.)"
dialogues.text: "(Suginami is another problem entirely.)"

dialogues.jp:
必要なとき以外は、不用意にあやつに関わらん
ほうがいい。
dialogues.en: He's only there whenever you least need him.
dialogues.text: He's only there whenever you least need him.

dialogues.jp: 鞄を肩にのせ、教室の扉を開け放つ。
dialogues.en:
With my bag on my shoulder, I opened the door leading
outside.
dialogues.text:
With my bag on my shoulder, I opened the door leading
outside.

dialogues.jp: 校門をでて、桜並木を歩く。
dialogues.en:
Heading out the school gate, I walked down the sakura tree
avenue.
dialogues.text:
Heading out the school gate, I walked down the sakura tree
avenue.

dialogues.jp:
屋上で鍋を食べていた関係で、帰宅ラッシュは
過ぎている。人通りのない道をてくてくと歩い
ていく。
dialogues.en:
Thanks to the extended feast on the rooftop, the usual rush
to return home had past. The path was nearly empty as I
walked.
dialogues.text:
Thanks to the extended feast on the rooftop, the usual rush
to return home had past. The path was nearly empty as I
walked.

dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp: なにか引っかかるもの感じ、２〜３歩戻る。
dialogues.en:
As I walked, something caught my eye. I took a few steps
back and looked closer.
dialogues.text:
As I walked, something caught my eye. I took a few steps
back and looked closer.

dialogues.jp:
道の脇に連なる桜の木の陰に隠れるように、二
人の学生が向かい合っているのが見えた。
dialogues.en:
At the side of the road, obscured by the many sakura trees,
was a couple of students.
dialogues.text:
At the side of the road, obscured by the many sakura trees,
was a couple of students.

dialogues.jp:
学園でもアイドル的存在のことりが、男とふた
りで向かい合っていた。
dialogues.en:
The school idol, Kotori, and a male student were the two
students I saw.
dialogues.text:
The school idol, Kotori, and a male student were the two
students I saw.

dialogues.jp:
相手の男は遠目にもガチガチに緊張しているの
が分かる。
dialogues.en:
Even from this far, I can tell that the guy was extremely
tense and nervous.
dialogues.text:
Even from this far, I can tell that the guy was extremely
tense and nervous.

dialogues.jp: （これは！？）
dialogues.en: "(This is?!)"
dialogues.text: "(This is?!)"

dialogues.jp: 今朝の杉並との会話を思い出す。
dialogues.en:
I recalled the conversation Suginami and I had earlier
today.
dialogues.text:
I recalled the conversation Suginami and I had earlier
today.

dialogues.jp: 卒業式間近の恒例、告白大会！
dialogues.en:
The school custom as graduation nears, the Confession
Tournament!
dialogues.text:
The school custom as graduation nears, the Confession
Tournament!

dialogues.jp:
ことりの表情には、緊張の色は見えないものの、
困ったような顔を浮かべていた。
dialogues.en:
Kotori's face showed no sign of worry. Instead, it showed
regretfulness and embarassment.
dialogues.text:
Kotori's face showed no sign of worry. Instead, it showed
regretfulness and embarassment.

dialogues.jp: 申し訳なさげに頭を下げることり。
dialogues.en: Her head bowed down in apology.
dialogues.text: Her head bowed down in apology.

dialogues.jp:
相手の男は顔の前で、ぎこちなく手を振ってい
る。
dialogues.en: The guy clumsily raised his hand to his face.
dialogues.text: The guy clumsily raised his hand to his face.

dialogues.jp:
ことりは何か喋ったあと、再び深々と頭を下げ、
男の前から走るように離れる。
dialogues.en:
Kotori said something, then after another deep bow, walked
away from the guy.
dialogues.text:
Kotori said something, then after another deep bow, walked
away from the guy.

dialogues.jp: （美しい青春の１ページだ）
dialogues.en:
"(Another beautiful page in the book of youthful
exuberance.)"
dialogues.text:
"(Another beautiful page in the book of youthful
exuberance.)"

dialogues.jp:
俺は走り去ることりの後姿を遠くから見送ると、
再び桜並木を歩いていく。
dialogues.en:
As I see Kotori's figure slowly disappear down the avenue, I
turn back and head to my own home.
dialogues.text:
As I see Kotori's figure slowly disappear down the avenue, I
turn back and head to my own home.

dialogues.jp: まずは――ひとり。
dialogues.en: ...All by myself.
dialogues.text: ...All by myself.

dialogues.jp: ◆一人で帰る◆
dialogues.en: ◆Home Alone◆
dialogues.text: ◆Home Alone◆

dialogues.jp: 一人で帰る事にした。
dialogues.en: I ended up walking home alone.
dialogues.text: I ended up walking home alone.

dialogues.jp:
途中、男子学生から告白を受けているらしいこ
とりを見かけた。
dialogues.en: On the way, I see a hapless student confessing to Kotori.
dialogues.text: On the way, I see a hapless student confessing to Kotori.

dialogues.jp: 全く、青春やのう……。
dialogues.en: Such is the beauty of youth...
dialogues.text: Such is the beauty of youth...
